name: Hotel Schalber
beschreibung: The Hotel Schalber is centrally located yet quiet in St. Johann in Tirol. The hotel is a family-run business with traditional Tiroler hospitality. The rooms are comfortably furnished, and many offer a balcony with mountain views. Half board includes a breakfast buffet and an evening menu with regional products. For relaxation, guests have access to a wellness area with sauna and steam bath. The mountain railways and the center of St. Johann are within walking distance. Guests use the hotel as a starting point for hikes and ski tours in the Kitzbüheler Alpen.
